=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/workflow_log_analysis_deliver_report.sh:188-200 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `unexpected_paths` check runs `git diff --no-renames --name-only HEAD "${run_ref}"` (line 192), which compares the deliver-report job's default-branch tip with the run-branch tip instead of the commit the run branch forked from, so any change merged to main during the run shows up as an unexpected path.
  WHY: If main advances while analyze-commit-notify is running (30+ minutes), unrelated non-doc paths fail the `WLA_DELIVER_DOC_RE` check, `wla_deliver_fail unexpected_paths` exits 1 and the report PR is never opened. glm also reports this as a trust-boundary gate whose scope is wrong in the over-strict direction. The run branch is fetched with `--depth=1` (line 168), so `git merge-base`/`${run_ref}^` are not available locally. Severity disagreement: glm=BLOCKER, gemini/minimax/luna=MAJOR; the highest is used. Note: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 explicitly rejected this in its pass-1 notes, saying both jobs check out the same `github.sha` on workflow_dispatch.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:806-813 (job tests-hooks-and-orchestrator at line 543) | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The required `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` job fails on head a2ae6b5f (check run 43076817476), which fails the dependent required `lint` gate ("CI jobs that did not succeed: tests-hooks-and-orchestrator"); the log tail stops inside `tests/test_lint_pr_body_auto_close.py` without a visible failing assertion.
  WHY: The PR cannot merge while `lint` is red. The cause is undetermined and could not be tied to a hunk. The #2734 `::error::` lines are intentional fixture output. The pre-push gate flagged `tests/test_orchestrate_lib.py` and `tests/test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py` as caused by this change. The full job log and a merge-base comparison are needed. All reviewers rated MAJOR (confidence 2–5).
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:1627-1641 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The "Commit and push report" push loop treats only `GH006|GH013|protected branch|push declined|repository rule` as terminal, so a non-fast-forward rejection on re-run (same `auto/workflow-log-analysis-report-<id>-<attempt>` branch) is retried 5× and then exits 1 with `reason=push_failed`.
  WHY: A workflow re-run can never deliver its report, even though the delivery script supports reruns. Both reviewers rated MAJOR. Note: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rejected this, saying re-running all jobs increments `GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT` (new branch) and re-running only failed jobs does not re-run the commit step.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "lint the PR body with scripts/lint_pr_body_auto_close.py before any push." (Enforced by §19 / §21)
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml PR body composition
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The PR body auto-close lint check-run failed because the generated PR body still contains auto-close keywords (e.g., 'Fixes' referencing issue #2734) in violation of §21; the lint must run before PR creation, or the body must be corrected before submission (note: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash state these #2734 lines are intentional test fixture output)
- requirement: "Verify with the next release-gate dispatch of `workflow-log-analysis.yml`" (PR description rollout, requiring a green mergeable PR)
  expected_change_site: failing test(s) in the `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` job, and possibly `tests/test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py` and `tests/test_orchestrate_lib.py` (fix or move to `ALLOWLIST_EXCEPTIONS` with justification)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: `pr_check_runs_context.txt` lists `lint` and `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` as failed on head `a2ae6b5f`; no hunk in `last_run_diff.patch` or `pr_diff.patch` references those test files; the editor's prior summary dismissed them as sandbox artifacts, but production CI on the full tree confirms the failure
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:job tests-hooks-and-orchestrator (line 543); the failing job's log tail ends in the step at line 813 (`PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 tests/test_lint_pr_body_auto_close.py`) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: On head a2ae6b5f, check run 43076817476 shows tests-hooks-and-orchestrator failing, so the required `lint` aggregator fails too. The failure could not be tied to any PR hunk. The test reads only files this PR does not change, the #2734 errors are fixture output of test_main_exit_codes, the PR body's "Closes .../issues/8963" refers to a sub-issue, and the new delivery cases run in tests-heal-plan-and-validation (ci.yml:1519), which passed.
  WHY: The required `lint` check stays red and blocks the merge. The editor needs the full job log and a merge-base run to decide whether the failure is inherited; do not attribute it to this PR without that evidence.
- scripts/workflow_log_analysis_deliver_report.sh:the `while IFS= read -r changed_path` loop after `git diff --no-renames --name-only HEAD "${run_ref}"` (HARDENING_SUGGESTION; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1)
  PROBLEM: Only path names are checked against WLA_DELIVER_DOC_RE, so a symlink (mode 120000) or gitlink at a matching analysis path would pass and go into the report PR.
  WHY: Suggested fix: read each existing path's mode via `git ls-tree "${run_ref}" -- "${changed_path}" | awk '{print $1}'` and call `wla_deliver_fail unexpected_paths` unless the mode is 100644 (an empty result, i.e. a deletion, is allowed); about 5 lines.
- (Pass-1 rejections: 5 related items) Rejected: the minimax claim that `unexpected_paths` compares against the main tip (both jobs check out `github.sha` on workflow_dispatch, and the commit step no longer rebases or merges); the glm claim of a non-fast-forward on re-run (`GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT` increments, giving a new branch); the gemini claim that test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py is caused by this PR (`workflow-log-analysis.yml` is in ALLOWLIST_EXCEPTIONS line 53); the gemini §21/#2734 claim (fixture output). Also confirmed that the release gate dispatches without `--ref` (test-and-mark-stable.yml:4250-4261), so `run_context_invalid` does not block it.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

  WHY: If main advances while analyze-commit-notify is in flight, new main files appear as changes and trigger a false-positive unexpected_paths failure that blocks delivery.

  WHY: The workflow fails at the delivery step on every rerun, which blocks report delivery.

  WHY: The PR cannot merge due to failing status checks.

- scripts/workflow_log_analysis_deliver_report.sh:line 192 (LAST RUN DIFF block "git diff --no-renames --name-only HEAD ${run_ref}") | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `unexpected_paths` check compares the run branch against `HEAD` (the main tip when deliver-report runs), not against the run branch's fork commit; analyze-commit-notify runs 30+ minutes, so a merge to main in that window advances `HEAD`.
  WHY: Files changed by the unrelated merge fail the `WLA_DELIVER_DOC_RE` check and `wla_deliver_fail unexpected_paths` exits 1, so the report PR is never opened. `test_delivery_rejects_run_branch_with_unexpected_paths` only tests the inverse case.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:lines 1627-1641, "Commit and push report" push loop (`git push origin "HEAD:refs/heads/${REPORT_BRANCH}"`) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Only output matching `GH006|GH013|protected branch|push declined|repository rule` is terminal; a non-fast-forward rejection on re-run (identical branch name) is retried up to 5 times and then exits 1 with `reason=push_failed`.
  WHY: The delivery script supports reruns (`test_delivery_rerun_after_rename_reuses_the_open_pr`, `Report-file:` recovery at script lines 202-211), but the commit step does not, so a re-run can never deliver its report.

  SEVERITY: BLOCKER

- scripts/workflow_log_analysis_deliver_report.sh:lines 191-200 (HARDENING_SUGGESTION; HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3)
  PROBLEM: Only path names are validated, so a symlink (mode 120000) or gitlink (mode 160000) at a path matching `^analysis/workflow-optimization-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}(-[0-9]+)?\.md$` passes and could be auto-merged into `main`.
